issues.title: [Roadmap] Arcaea-Viewer Web MVP 0.1 — synthetic-first product and controlled publication
issues.outcome: Deliver a production-ready wiki skeleton and original UI using synthetic data, then obtain lowiro authorization, integrate only the approved Arcaea data scope, and activate public release through an explicit evidence-backed gate.
scope: Track six implementation phases from discovery through controlled preview and public-release activation.
Allow skeleton, UI, schemas, tests, and deployment infrastructure to progress with synthetic records and project-authored placeholders.
Keep real Arcaea data, official media, extracted resources, public Arcaea-specific indexing, and production release behind written authorization and final maintainer approval.
Keep runtime/viewer work outside the Web MVP critical path.
nonGoals: Do not extract, scrape, datamine, or redistribute proprietary Arcaea resources.
Do not treat a deployed synthetic preview as permission to publish Arcaea data.
Do not require a hosted database before measured requirements justify one.
technicalConstraints: UI code consumes a repository/data-adapter contract rather than importing raw domain files directly.
The pre-authorization implementation uses synthetic records and project-authored placeholders only.
Silence or absence of a lowiro response is not authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: All six phase epics and both publication gates are represented by managed issues.
The roadmap distinguishes synthetic preview from an Arcaea-specific public release.
Every issue states whether it may use synthetic data, permission-approved data, or no domain data.
The critical path can produce a credible deployed prototype before lowiro authorization.
Public release cannot activate until authorization, approved-data integration, content audit, QA, and rollback evidence are complete.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.
